answer: The river edge is logged both ways, so a closed ring of 17 clones produces a signature the mirror analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. Anyone must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the umber settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 26 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
